title: Mechanical Cartridge Seal
model_title: Mechanical Cartridge Seal (Single, Pusher Type) with Flush (API Plan 11)

introduction.definition: A mechanical cartridge seal seals a rotating shaft with two very flat faces — one rotating with the shaft, one stationary in the gland — pressed together by springs and fluid pressure. A micro-thin liquid film between the faces lubricates them. The cartridge comes pre-assembled on its own sleeve and gland, set with clips that are removed after installation.
applications: Process pumps in refineries, chemical and water plants

pressure.title: A micro-thin film seals across the faces
pressure.description: Springs and the hydraulic closing force press the rotating face against the stationary seat. Liquid from the chamber (outside diameter) forms a film of only ≈ 0.5–1 µm between the lapped faces, and its pressure falls across the face width to atmosphere at the inside diameter. Balance ratio (≈ 0.7–0.85 for balanced seals) sets the face load. The flush (Plan 11: from discharge to the seal chamber) removes heat and keeps the faces cool; running dry destroys the faces in seconds. A cartridge is pre-assembled and pre-set, so installation errors are fewer — but the setting clips must be removed before start-up.

video_tutorials.title: Mechanical Cartridge Seal — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Mechanical Cartridge Seal.
A mechanical cartridge seal seals a rotating shaft with two very flat faces — one rotating with the shaft, one stationary in the gland — pressed together by springs and fluid pressure.
A micro-thin liquid film between the faces lubricates them.
The cartridge comes pre-assembled on its own sleeve and gland, set with clips that are removed after installation.
Typical applications include process pumps in refineries, chemical and water plants; mixers, agitators and compressors (gas seals).

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Seal Chamber (pump casing back plate), Rotating Unit: Spring Retainer, 8 Small Springs, Face Holder & Drive Collar with Set Screws (turning), Pump Shaft (turning).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Mechanical Cartridge Seal — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Mechanical Cartridge Seal.
Check for leakage and gland temperature.
Check flush line, orifice and cooler.
Exchange cartridge; refurbish faces.
Watch for dry running: squeal, heat, rapid leakage. Common cause: pump started empty, flush blocked.
Watch for setting clips left in: clips rub and break, seal damaged. Common cause: installation error.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
